# KK Create — Learn to Earn Through Content

> A live online workshop by KK Create for content creators who want to turn their content into income. It runs on Saturday, 24 October 2026, from 12 PM to 4 PM IST, in Hinglish (mostly Hindi with some English), and is taught by Lokesh Yadav, co-founder of KK Create. Enrolment includes lifetime access to the recording, a certificate, and 3 free bonuses worth ₹9,500.

KK Create is an Indian content creator brand founded by Kavya Karnatac and Lokesh Yadav (12M+ followers, 3.9B+ views on YouTube). Contact: support@kkcreate.in.

## The workshop

- [Workshop page and enrolment](https://finance.kkcreate.in/): dates, curriculum, bonuses, mentor, testimonials and FAQ.
- When: Saturday, 24 October 2026, 12 PM–4 PM IST, live online. Any device works, including a phone.
- Language: Hinglish.
- Missed it live? The recording is sent within 24–48 hours and can be watched any time.
- Who it is for: beginners, creators with low views, and anyone who has not cracked monetisation yet. A big following is not required.

### What it covers

1. How money works in the creator economy: where creator income comes from, why structure beats luck, thinking like a professional.
2. Proven ways to make money from content: 5 income streams, brand deals as the quickest path, audience products and services.
3. How brands think about money: what makes brands pay creators, aligning content with brand goals, why brands value risk reduction.
4. Creating content that brands love: formats that work, integrations vs dedicated content, building a media kit.
5. Pricing, outreach and closing deals: pricing on real value, offers that get responses, outreach that closes.
6. Turning deals into repeat income: delivering results, managing timelines and approvals, building repeat deals.

### Free bonuses (sent within 24 hours after the workshop)

- Our Brand Scripts (worth ₹4,000): how to write scripts for brands, from the ones KK Create used.
- The Pricing Playbook (worth ₹2,500): find your worth and what to charge.
- Outreach Simplified (worth ₹3,000): brand outreach templates that get replies.

### Mentor

Lokesh Yadav left the Indian Audit and Accounts Service at 27 to co-found KK Create with Kavya Karnatac. He runs the business side: brand deals, AdSense, subscriptions, revenue systems and creator monetisation.
